verdict.rationale: Tavily publishes a documented public REST API. The reference docs cover search, extract (batch up to 20 URLs), crawl, map, research (async retrieval by request ID, plus streaming), usage, and logs endpoints. Rate limits are documented, including 429 responses with a retry-after header. Official Python (sync and async) and JS/TS SDKs wrap the API, and a community user reports having agents drive the paid API. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, since every probed openapi/swagger path returned 404.
